notes.title: English Version in progress!
notes.notes:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30200949/86897db83d0b19cb316a2cb935a114e62e5d68e5.jpg

To English-speaking players: thank you so much for your support for "The Prototype"! Although the text of our game is originally written in Chinese, we have been longing to translate it into English, in order to have it enjoyed by a wider range of players around the world. 

We are thrilled to report to you that we are adding the finishing touches to the game, and its Chinese version will be released soon around the end of the month. The completion of programming and graphics, etc. means that the focus of our work will finally be directed towards English translation and localization. Hopefully, we will release the English version by mid-May. 

We apologize for being unable to release both versions simultaneously; it's due to our desire to ensure the production of sterling work and maximization of your enjoyment :D Again, thank you very much for your patience and support for our game!

Sincerely,
Hairgel Agency
